text: Lyft priced its IPO on March 28, 2019 at $72 a share and closed its first day at $78.29, which stayed its highest close. The stock fell to a low of $7.99 on May 24, 2023, and closed the five years at $18.58 on April 2, 2024, 74.2% below the offer price. Its filings show heavy losses, a pandemic collapse in demand, a restatement of prior results, and a weak profit outlook that preceded a change of chief executive.
